maddeler.e:
اعتمدوا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَمَدُوا (iʕtamadū) /iʕ.ta.ma.duː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# اُعْتُمِدُوا (uʕtumidū) /uʕ.tu.mi.duː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# اِعْتَمِدُوا (iʕtamidū) /iʕ.ta.mi.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
